title: GCP Analyst - Finance
description:
Drive business value through procurement and spend analytics, cloud-based data solutions, reporting automation, AI-enabled insights, and strong data governance. The role combines hands-on technical delivery with business analysis, stakeholder engagement, migration support, validation, and production ownership.

  

**Required skills and qualifications**
--------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, statistics, mathematics, business analytics or a related field.
* 4–5 years of relevant experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting automation or analytics consulting.
* Strong procurement process and business knowledge; experience with P2P or spend analytics is preferred.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of Python, Pandas, PySpark, SQL/HQL and cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery.
* Strong Alteryx capability covering workflow development, data blending, transformation, validation, optimization and scheduling.
* Working knowledge of AI/ML and GenAI concepts, prompt design, AI-assisted analytics, model/output evaluation and responsible AI controls.
* Experience with Tableau capabilities, including dashboard development and interactive analytics; Power BI knowledge is an advantage.
* Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills, with strong analytical, troubleshooting and presentation capability.
* Experience managing enterprise-level initiatives and enhancing or automating reporting structures.
* Ability to work autonomously, make sound decisions under ambiguity and time pressure, and collaborate effectively across teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical findings to non-technical audiences.
* Curiosity and willingness to learn new open-source technologies, languages and AI-enabled methods.

**Preferred experience**

* Cloud analytics platforms, code repositories, deployment pipelines and scheduled workflow management.
* Data migration, cutover, UAT/DVT, reconciliation and production stabilization.
* Data privacy, PII handling, access governance, controls and compliance reporting.
* Process documentation, SOP creation, transition planning and hands-on knowledge transfer.

**Success measures**

* Reliable continuity of critical reporting, mapping and monitoring processes.
* Measurable reduction in manual effort through Python, Alteryx and AI-enabled automation.
* Accurate, well-governed and timely analytical outputs with clear validation evidence.
* Successful migration and stabilization of data assets, codes and dashboards.
* Clear documentation, effective stakeholder communication and sustainable knowledge transfer.

  

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

  

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

* Competitive base salaries
* Bonus incentives
* Support for financial-well-being and retirement
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
* Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
* Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
* Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
* Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.

Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

title: AIOps Architect
description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*

We are seeking an **AIOps Architect** to lead the AI, agentic automation, and observability architecture for our Software Development Platform (SDP) Services, a 400–500 cloud Python app estate supporting revenue-critical capabilities including Algo Trading, Quant Models, and Data Loaders. In this role, you will own the autonomous operations layer, ensuring reliable, governed execution across 48 tier-one critical apps with sub-2h RTO, 45 databases, and 320 production environments spanning 12 countries.

**Responsibilities**

* Define and maintain the AI-driven monitoring and observability architecture for the SDP platform estate
* Design and operate automated triage and incident classification processes, routing by business capability and technical stack before L2 engagement
* Provide technical governance on platform-layer changes, guardrails, and patterns for the low-code/no-code environment
* Serve as the technical interface to the SDP platform governance function
* Surface operational failure patterns and propose platform-side remediation
* Ensure SLA adherence, including P1 15 min/4 h, P2 30 min/8 h, with 24×7 coverage for highly critical applications

**Requirements**

* 14+ years of overall IT experience, with hands-on experience in platform/solution architecture and AI/ML or AIOps
* Experience building autonomous multi-agent workflows, LLMOps pipelines, RAG systems, and tool-use integrations across platforms such as Datadog, Jira, and AWS APIs
* Background in cloud-hosted Python environments, with AWS preferred, including distributed databases and low-code/no-code platform governance
* Familiarity with enterprise monitoring tooling such as Datadog, Dynatrace, and Prometheus/Grafana, managing 300+ production environments
* Experience governing low-code/no-code platforms
* Exceptional ability to communicate technical risks and operational status to non-technical business application owners

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks & Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
  + Health benefits
  + Retirement benefits
  + Paid time off
  + Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

title: Global IT Quality Engineer Manager
description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

The People Digital Product Portfolio is the largest and most dynamic product portfolio within BCG’s Digital Products Organization. We enable global technology for BCG’s People Function, including Recruiting; Talent Management (Staffing, Mobility & Career Development); L&D; and Core HR (including Workday, Compensation and Benefits).

We are seeking a **Global Quality Engineer Manager** to lead quality engineering execution for our **Vendor Management System (VMS)** products. This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on ensuring the quality, reliability, and scalability of enterprise SaaS applications through effective manual and automated testing.

**You will:**

* Lead and mentor quality engineers across manual and automated testing, providing technical guidance, coaching, and quality oversight.
* Develop and execute test strategies for the VMS product/platform, aligned with established quality engineering standards.
* Remain hands-on with test automation, contributing to framework development, implementation, and code reviews.
* Drive automation initiatives to improve test coverage, efficiency, reliability, and release confidence.
* Ensure comprehensive testing of VMS workflows, business rules, APIs, integrations, databases, and backend services.
* Partner with product owners, business analysts, and engineers to translate requirements into effective test scenarios, including negative, boundary, integration, and edge cases.
* Collaborate with development and DevOps teams to integrate automated testing into **CI/CD pipelines** and enable continuous testing.
* Lead defect triage and root cause analysis for complex or recurring issues and work with engineering teams on preventive actions.
* Track and report quality metrics, including defect trends, test coverage, automation coverage, and defect leakage, to identify risks and improvement opportunities.
* Provide quality assessments and recommendations to support release readiness and release decisions.
* Recommend and adopt appropriate testing tools and technologies to improve quality engineering effectiveness.
* Drive adoption of established QA practices and foster a **quality-first culture** within the VMS team.

What You'll Bring

**Required Experience:**

* **8+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance / Quality Engineering**, with expertise in both manual and automation testing.
* Experience leading or technically guiding QA/Quality Engineering teams and mentoring engineers.
* Strong hands-on experience developing and maintaining automated test suites and frameworks.
* Experience testing **SaaS-based enterprise products,** preferably multi-tenant and cloud-native applications.
* Experience testing workflow-driven enterprise platforms such as **Vendor Management, Procurement, Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), HR, or similar business applications**.
* Experience across functional, integration, regression, API, UI, end-to-end, and data validation testing.
* Experience working with APIs, databases, backend services, and enterprise system integrations.
* Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience working in **Agile/Scrum environments** with globally distributed, cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Experience testing SaaS-based **Vendor Management or Procurement platforms such as SAP Fieldglass, Coupa, or similar enterprise workflow applications.**
* Experience with performance and load testing.
* Exposure to **AI-enabled testing tools or applications of AI within Quality Engineering.**

**Key Skills**

* Strong understanding of **QA methodologies, SDLC, STLC, Agile testing practices, and Quality Engineering principles**.
* Hands-on expertise with **Playwright (preferred) or Selenium**.
* Experience with automation approaches such as **Page Object Model (POM), Hybrid, and Data-Driven frameworks.**
* Proficiency in **Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python** for automation scripting.
* Experience with **API testing using Postman**; knowledge of **REST Assured** or similar frameworks is an advantage.
* Experience with test and defect management tools such as **JIRA, Zephyr, and QMetry**.
* Experience with Git and CI/CD tools such as **Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or equivalent technologies.**
* Strong understanding of enterprise SaaS applications, APIs, integrations, databases, and workflow-driven systems.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities.

Who You'll Work With

You’ll work with a globally distributed, cross-functional team of **product owners, business analysts, software engineers, DevOps engineers, architects, quality engineers, and business stakeholders** in a fast-paced Agile environment.

As a hands-on technical quality leader, you will mentor quality engineers and partner with product and engineering teams to ensure quality is embedded throughout the development lifecycle

Additional info

**You’re Good At:**

**Technical Leadership**

* Providing clear technical direction while remaining hands-on when needed.
* Coaching and developing quality engineers.
* Raising engineering standards through constructive reviews and knowledge sharing.

**Problem Solving & Decision Making**

* Anticipating risks and identifying issues early.
* Making pragmatic, risk-based decisions while balancing quality, timelines, and business priorities.
* Navigating complex technical and business problems with sound judgment.

**Communication & Collaboration**

* Communicating clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Influencing teams and building alignment across functions and geographies.
* Giving and receiving constructive feedback effectively.

**Work Management & Organization**

* Managing multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
* Demonstrating strong attention to detail while maintaining focus on broader outcomes.
* Taking ownership and driving work through to completion.

**Customer & Business Focus**

* Understanding business workflows and the impact of product quality on users.
* Balancing technical quality with business needs and user experience.
* Maintaining a strong focus on reliable and scalable product outcomes.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Challenging existing ways of working and identifying practical opportunities for improvement.
* Staying current with evolving quality engineering technologies and practices.
* Promoting learning, experimentation, and continuous improvement within the team.

**Values & Ethics**

* Demonstrating accountability, sound judgment, and integrity.
* Handling confidential business and user information appropriately.

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Industry Architect
description:

Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

Every day, you'll tackle new challenges, driving the completion of intricate technical designs and builds that meet our clients' diverse business requirements.  
  
Your role will involve providing valuable advice on the application of your specializations, contributing significantly to solution design, business development, and project transitions from presales to delivery. You'll select and apply the right design standards, methods, and tools, ensuring they are effectively incorporated into our enterprise and solution architectures.  
  
You'll also engage in mapping business processes, ensuring the recommended approaches support the overall scope of the solution. Your duties will include guiding the successful implementation and execution of system solutions, designing components using appropriate modelling techniques, and offering valuable pre-sales technical support to analyse client needs effectively.  
  
This role allows you to influence and guide sales team members, helping them close deals while also managing client proof-of-concept (POC) initiatives. You'll also provide coaching and mentoring to junior technical architects, fostering their professional development and ensuring high-performance delivery across the board.

* Ability to develop and leverage knowledge of reference architectures.

* Proven client engagement and development consulting experience.
* Experience working in agile development environments.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills to build and maintain client relationships.
* A continuous learning mindset to stay updated on trends and developments in technology domains.
* A bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or Information Systems.

On-site Working

NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune

Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through

responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with

unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and

application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move

established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each

year in R&D.

**Technical Skills**

title: Expert Senior Manager, AI Engineering
description:
What Makes Us a Great Place to Work
  
  
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on [1] Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)
  
  
Bain’s [2] AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into robust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.
  
  
The Impact You’ll Have
  
  
Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.
  
  
As an AI Engineering leader in AIS, you will support the building of the technical core within these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.
  
  
The Role
  
  
The Expert Senior Manager AI Engineer will architect, build, and scale next-generation generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. As a leader in the practice, you will sit at the intersection of advanced engineering, applied AI research, product strategy, and responsible AI governance. You will own the full lifecycle — from research and experimentation to production deployment and ongoing optimization — and guide teams across engineering, product, data science, ethics, and client stakeholders.
  
  
You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.
  
  
Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn while doing, with support from other experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Design, build, and deploy end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
* Architect multi-component pipelines, including:
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
* Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
* Embedding generation and optimization
* Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)
* Integrate reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across complex workflows
* Engineer advanced agentic systems, ensuring clear separation of concerns, robust memory architecture, and scalable tool ecosystems
* Lead everything from early-stage research, model experimentation, and evaluation design to production system deployment
* Oversee API development, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and cloud-native deployment
* Build scalable GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
* Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:
* Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
* Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards
* Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
* Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering:
* Hallucination rate and factual consistency
* Relevance and precision/recall
* Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
* Cost tracking and efficiency
* Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
* Act as a thought partner to executives and clients on AI strategy, architecture decisions, emerging capabilities, and implementation roadmaps
* Mentor and upskill technical teams on best practices including RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* 8-12+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with significant hands-on building responsibilities
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-stack generative AI programs from conception through production
* Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate highly technical concepts to business stakeholders
* Track record of leading engineering teams, mentoring technical talent, and collaborating with diverse cross-functional groups
* Advanced prompt engineering, context engineering, and conversation design
* Strong expertise in evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM apps
* Deep experience with:
* Advanced RAG architectures (vector, hybrid, graph-based retrieval)
* Agentic architectures (multi-agent systems, tool selection, routing, memory, planning, reflection)
* ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops.
* AI-Specific Tools & Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems
* Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment
* Deep familiarity with cost optimization and computational tradeoffs for LLM workloads
* Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments with collaborative cross-functional teams
* Clear ability to lead, mentor, and inspire technical teams
* Experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise transformation environments is a strong plus

Working Model & Travel
  

* This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.
* Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.

References
  
  
Visible links
  
1. https://www.bain.com/about/awards-recognition/
  
2. https://www.bain.com/careers/work-with-us/integrated-teams/ai-insights-solutions-ais/

**Overview**

Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI) is a leading global investment bank recognized for delivering independent strategic and financial advice to corporations, financial sponsors, and governments. With uniquely deep industry expertise, broad international reach, and a partnership approach rooted in trust, the firm provides innovative, integrated solutions across mergers and acquisitions, capital solutions, financial restructuring, and financial and valuation advisory. Our unmatched transaction volumes provide differentiated, data-driven perspectives that help our clients achieve their most critical goals. To learn more about Houlihan Lokey, please visit HL.com.

**Scope**

We're looking for a seasoned Senior Platform Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team. You will design, build, and evolve our cloud-native platform that powers high-scale applications and AI infrastructure. You'll drive automation, reliability, cost-efficiency, and developer experience across our CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, Kubernetes platforms, observability, and security controls. This role blends hands-on technical leadership with people management.

**Responsibilities**

* **Data Platform Ownership:** Architect, implement, and operate a robust internal data platform (Kubernetes- and cloud-based) enabling self-service data ingestion, scalable processing workloads, and standardized data quality guardrails.
* CI/CD Enablement: Implement and optimize pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions) for build/test/deploy, artifact management, and promotion strategies (blue/green, canary).
* **ETL Frameworks & Pipeline Engineering:** Design, build, and scale modular, reusable ETL/ELT frameworks and automated ingestion pipelines (batch and streaming) to ingest and process high-throughput financial, transactional, and analytical datasets.
* **Data Modeling & Architecture:** Define and implement robust dimensional and relational data models (Star/Snowflake schemas, One Big Table, medallion lakehouse architecture) optimizing for query performance, reporting, and downstream machine learning/analytics.
* **Data Pipeline Orchestration:** Architect and maintain resilient workflow orchestration systems (e.g., Apache Airflow, Dagster, Prefect) managing complex DAG dependencies, SLA tracking, backfill strategies, and automated failure retries.
* Developer Experience: Improve inner-loop productivity with golden paths, templates, and CLI tooling; champion platform usability and documentation.
* Mentorship & Collaboration: Coach engineers, partner with architecture, and product teams; lead technical initiatives and production readiness reviews.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent experience
* 4+ years in Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, or SRE, with proven experience owning production-grade data platforms and ETL pipelines
* Strong hands-on expertise in at least one major cloud; multi-cloud experience is a plus
* Advanced proficiency in SQL and dimensional data modeling (Kimball methodology, star/snowflake schemas, or medallion lakehouse architecture)
* Strong Knowledge in Data Structures, Programming Language preferably Python, Golang, TypeScript
* Deep experience designing and maintaining scalable ETL/ELT frameworks and pipeline orchestration (e.g., Airflow, dbt, Spark, Dagster)
* Designing secure, scalable pipelines and release strategies; experience with feature flags and progressive delivery
* Solid grasp of cloud infrastructure fundamentals across networking, load balancing, service discovery; Linux systems expertise
* Strong communication skills and proven stakeholder management capabilities
* Proven leadership and mentoring skills

***We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.***

Summary:
  

AI Powered Tech Talent  

Role Summary / Description  

Engineer role in AI LLM Technology Architecture for Level 8/9\. Hands\-on engineering role focused on designing, building, integrating, testing and operationalizing enterprise\-grade LLM, GenAI and agentic AI components across active client engagements.  

Own platform\-specific engineering on Azure, translating high\-level architecture into working, production\-quality components for LLM\-driven applications, RAG pipelines, multi\-agent workflows and AI platform integrations.

Design and build LLM application components including prompts, tools, agents, orchestration flows, memory/context handling, retrieval pipelines and evaluation harnesses.  

Create Foundry\-based agents with enterprise tools, knowledge and memory integrate Azure AI Search for RAG implement secure API/tool calls through API Management, Logic Apps and Functions instrument traces, evaluations, guardrails and policy controls for production agents.

Engineer safety and control components including PII detection/redaction, prompt\-injection defenses, content filters, guardrails, authentication, authorization, lineage and audit logging.  

Collaborate with architects, data engineers, product owners and security stakeholders to convert solution designs into tested, observable and maintainable software components.  

Maintain technical artifacts such as component designs, integration specifications, deployment runbooks, evaluation results and reusable engineering patterns.  

  

Required Qualifications  

Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, Information Technology or a related engineering discipline.

Level 8: typically 7\+ years of software/data/AI engineering experience, including 3\+ years in cloud\-native architecture/engineering and 1–2\+ years in GenAI, LLM, NLP or agentic AI delivery.  

Hands\-on coding experience in Python and strong understanding of APIs, distributed systems, CI/CD, testing, observability and secure SDLC practices.  

Experience delivering AI/ML or data products in at least one industry domain such as banking, insurance, healthcare, public sector, retail or energy.  

  

Required Skills/ Experience  

Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Foundry / Azure AI Foundry, Foundry Agent Service, Azure OpenAI models, Azure AI Search, Prompt Flow, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Event Grid, Microsoft Fabric, Entra ID, Key Vault, Azure Monitor and Application Insights.  

Strong understanding of LLM application architecture patterns including RAG, function/tool calling, agent orchestration, model invocation, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases and evaluation metrics.  

Ability to implement traditional ML and GenAI components across ingestion, feature/data preparation, model integration, deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement.  

Practical knowledge of security, privacy, governance, performance, scalability, reliability and cost controls for production AI systems.  

Experience with Git\-based development, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure\-as\-code and agile delivery in client\-facing environments.  

  

Good to Have Skills  

Azure AI Engineer, Azure Solutions Architect or Azure Developer certification experience with Microsoft Fabric, Semantic Kernel, Prompt Flow, private networking, Defender for Cloud and enterprise Responsible AI governance.  

Exposure to open\-source frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Haystack, MLflow, FastAPI, Docker and Kubernetes.  

Experience with Responsible AI, model risk management, synthetic data generation, human\-in\-the\-loop review, A/B testing and GenAI cost optimization.

title: Global IT Platform Engineer Manager - Azure & Power Platform
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


The **IT Platform Engineer Specialist \- Azure \& Power Platform** supports the engineering, evolution, and day\-to\-day operations of the Digital Marketing platform, hosted in the Azure Cloud. You will take reliable ownership of core Azure infrastructure and operations tasks — provisioning services, setting up monitoring, managing credential lifecycle, and applying tagging and cost\-code discipline — as well as CI/CD pipelines for Power Platform solutions, while building a basic working understanding of Azure Function Apps and Azure API Management (APIM).


This is an ideal role for someone early in their cloud and platform engineering career who is curious about how modern Azure platforms are run day to day, is eager to invest in continuous learning through a Center of Excellence, and wants a clear path toward architectural design exposure, multi\-platform ownership, and deeper Azure API and software development capabilities.

 **Azure Cloud Infrastructure \& Operations**

* Provision and configure core Azure services — including subscriptions, service bus, key vault, and function apps — to support the Digital Marketing team’s applications.
* Set up monitoring and insights across both Azure infrastructure and Power Platform flows, giving teams clear visibility into system health.
* Proactively manage the credential lifecycle — documenting and tracking expirations to prevent outages or security gaps.
* Apply tagging and cost\-code reporting to support budget accountability across the Azure environment.

**CI/CD \& Deployment**

* Own deployment pipelines for Power Platform solutions using GitHub Actions, enhancing low\-code / no\-code delivery.
* Build a basic working understanding of creating Azure Function Apps and configuring Azure API Management (APIM), supporting senior engineers on delivery tasks.

**Working Style \& Team Contribution**

* Take reliable ownership of assigned tasks and see them through completion.
* Actively engage in team ceremonies, with genuine curiosity about sprint work beyond assigned tickets.
* Contribute to knowledge\-sharing and continuous improvement activities across the team.
* Show a strong willingness to learn new cloud and platform engineering capabilities.
* Invest in public speaking and mentoring outside of work.

**Areas of Learning \& Growth**

* Build exposure to architectural design and reusable platform patterns.
* Progress toward owning multi\-platform engagements end\-to\-end.
* Deepen Azure API configurations and software development capabilities.

  

What You'll Bring

* 3 or more years of hands\-on experience with Azure Cloud
* Working familiarity with core Azure services — subscriptions, service bus, key vault, function apps — or the ability to ramp up quickly
* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, ideally with GitHub Actions (Azure DevOps also acceptable)
* Familiarity with the Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate) or a strong willingness to learn low\-code / no\-code delivery
* Basic understanding of monitoring, logging, and observability concepts (Azure Monitor, Application Insights, or similar)
* Comfort with credential and secret management practices in a cloud environment
* Familiarity with version control using Git / GitHub
* Nice to have:
* Exposure to creating Azure Function Apps and configuring Azure API Management (APIM)
* Microsoft certifications such as AZ\-900 (Azure Fundamentals) or PL\-900 (Power Platform Fundamentals)
* Experience contributing to a Center of Excellence, tech community, or internal knowledge\-sharing initiative
* Awareness of AI capabilities for Azure.

  

Who You'll Work With


You will work within the Digital Marketing platform engineering team across multiple geographies, learning under the guidance of senior platform engineers and collaborating with architects, security, and application teams. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to internal tools used globally across BCG while building the foundations of a broader platform engineering career.

  

Additional info

**YOU'RE GOOD AT**

  

Strong task ownership, attention to detail, and a demonstrable habit of continuous learning

 *"At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.*

title: QE Manager
description:
About This Role
**6 years of experience**  

**Skills: Selenium, Playwright, Java / Python, REST API Testing, BDD / Cucumber, JUnit / Mockito, CI/CD, Postman / RestAssured, Performance Testing, Git, SQL, Agile, Shift\-Left Testing, Defect Management, JIRA**

**About the Role**
  

We are looking for an experienced Quality Engineer with 6\+ years of experience to design, build, and execute automated test solutions across enterprise applications. You will bring strong test automation skills combined with solid domain knowledge — embedding quality as a first\-class concern across Agile delivery teams. This is a hands\-on technical QE role requiring strong coding ability, deep automation framework expertise, and a shift\-left quality mindset.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Design, build, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks covering UI, API, integration, and E2E testing layers.
* Develop automation scripts using Selenium WebDriver or Playwright supporting functional, regression, and cross\-browser testing.
* Build and maintain REST API test automation suites using RestAssured, Karate, or Postman covering API contracts and business logic validation.
* Write unit and integration tests using JUnit and Mockito collaborating with developers to improve code testability and test coverage.
* Build and maintain BDD test frameworks using Cucumber and Gherkin working with product owners and BAs to define business\-readable acceptance criteria.
* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines implementing quality gates that prevent defective code from reaching production.
* Champion shift\-left testing practices engaging with developers and architects early in the delivery lifecycle.
* Design and execute performance and load tests using JMeter or Gatling validating application scalability under realistic load conditions.
* Manage defect triage and reporting logging, prioritising, and tracking defects in Jira with clear business impact assessment.
* Mentor and coach junior QE team members sharing automation expertise across the team.

**What We're Looking For**


* 6\+ years of quality engineering experience with strong hands\-on technical automation expertise.
* Strong automation skills using Selenium WebDriver or Playwright building scalable, maintainable frameworks from scratch.
* Solid Java or Python skills writing production\-quality test automation code.
* Proven REST API testing expertise using RestAssured, Karate, or Postman.
* Experience with BDD frameworks including Cucumber and Gherkin for business\-readable test scenario automation.
* Strong CI/CD integration experience embedding quality gates into Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions pipelines.
* Good SQL skills for data validation and reconciliation testing.
* Strong shift\-left testing mindset engaging early in the delivery lifecycle to define testability and quality requirements.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills working effectively across developers, product owners, and DevOps teams.

**Nice to Have**


* Performance and load testing experience using JMeter, Gatling, or k6\.
* Contract testing experience using Pact or Spring Cloud Contract.
* Accessibility testing knowledge including WCAG standards and Axe tools.
* AI assisted testing tools including Mabl, Testim, or Applitools.
* ISTQB Foundation or Advanced certification.
* Experience in Financial Services, Banking, or regulated industry environments.

title: Senior Distributed Application Support
description:
**About Our Company**


Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1\.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year\-end 2024\. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.


Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

**Job Description**


In this role the person will be the responsible for ensuring success of business critical application operations by supporting the day to day batch processing, analyzing and fixing the issues on priority while adhering to standards and SLA's. The person should be able to support High priority(P1/P2\) incidents dynamically by providing timely resolution for the problem and handle other service requests. The person will also be responsible for handling minor enhancements, perform code reviews, handle application outages(planned/unplanned) and responsible for performance and maintenance of the highly critical business application. For this role we are looking for a highly motivated Individual who will be working as Sr. operations analysts working in technologies. The person should exhibit leadership qualities and demonstrate business acumen while working closely with business users to understand requirements and help team translate it into technical changes.  

Provide end to end production support and derive immediate resolutions/root\-cause of the incidents arising in and around the Legal, Compliance and Supervision Application’s Distributed systems to ensure quick restoration of service degradation and hence minimal business impact.**Key Responsibilities**

* Work as part of Operations team primarily supporting the Distributed applications
* Respond to incidents as well as work to identify proactive incident circumvention
* Support the Batch Operations that occurs nightly for Distributed systems
* Work on rotation basis during the day and night Operations shift to support both night batches and the day time Operations work alternatively
* Identify and recommend performance enhancements/improvements for applications
* Provide 24x7 on\-call support and work during hours that accommodate a portion of the US work day or during the full US work day shift (India night shift) including weekends / holidays


Incident \& Problem Management

* Work towards quick resolution/recovery of the high priority incidents in a time\-bound manner to ensure business continuity and minimum downtimes
* Coordinate and drive restoration of service disruptions/business escalated issues to meet and exceed established SLAs/OLAs
* Ensure action plans are in place to address recurring issues, including escalation and effective hand\-off to other teams as required
* Work towards aggressive root cause analysis/permanent resolution for all the business impacting recurring technical issues


Change Management

* Participate in change reviews and understand operational impacts due to changes
* Continuous Service Improvement Initiatives
* Improve effectiveness and efficiency of existing processes
* Follow best practices to enhance service delivery
* Develop the ability to think and act strategically
* Engage in the business and technology interactions to improve the service quality
* Ensure appropriate quality checks to decrease the risks and errors
* Ensure to execute processes to optimize cost and quality

  

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.
* 4\-8 years of experience in Production Support, Application Operations, Cloud Operations, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) roles.
* Strong experience supporting distributed applications in Production environments.
* Hands\-on experience troubleshooting applications hosted in AWS Cloud environments including EC2, S3, Lambda, SNS, SQS, RDS and CloudWatch.
* Strong experience with: SQL and database troubleshooting Windows Server and Linux administration Java and/or .NET application support Enterprise batch scheduling platforms such as TWS (IBM Workload Scheduler), Tidal, Control\-M or equivalent
* Practical scripting experience with Bash Shell and PowerShell for production support, troubleshooting, operational automation, monitoring and batch processing.
* Experience automating manual operational tasks using PowerShell, Bash, Python or AWS native automation services.
* Experience supporting ETL workflows, data pipelines, file transfers and batch processing environments.
* Experience using monitoring and observability tools such as Dynatrace, Sumo Logic, CloudWatch or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of ITIL practices including Incident, Problem and Change Management.
* Proven experience in root cause analysis, service restoration and proactive incident prevention.

 **Preferred Qualifications**  

Candidates who have used following tools (or have familiarity with below) will have added advantage:•

* AWS Certified SysOps Administrator Associate (Highly Preferred)
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate (Optional)
* ITIL Foundation Certification
* Experience supporting financial services, compliance, supervision, legal, or highly regulated applications.
* Experience with: AWS Cloud Operations DevOps and CI/CD concepts Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation) Python automation development
* Knowledge of ETL platforms such as Informatica, AWS Glue, IDMC, or equivalent.
* Experience building operational dashboards, monitoring solutions, and automated alerting mechanisms.
* Knowledge of Mainframe environments and scheduling integrations is a plus.
* Proven track record of identifying automation opportunities and reducing operational overhead through scripting and process improvements.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a proactive operational mindset

**In\-Office Collaboration**

* We are a client\-centric, relationship\-based business. Working together, in\-person, is foundational to how we achieve results. By fostering a culture of face\-to\-face collaboration, idea sharing, productivity and personal connection, we deliver for our stakeholders — clients, advisors, employees and shareholders. Our employees work in the office at least three (3\) days per week, with flexibility to work from home two (2\) days per week.
